name: Fresh Canna Live Resin | Gelato 33
description: Indulge in the creamy, dessert-like delight of Fresh Canna’s Live Resin Wax – Gelato 33, a top-tier hybrid that blends potency, flavor, and relaxation into one smooth experience. Extracted from fresh-frozen cannabis, this live resin wax is packed with terpenes and cannabinoids, delivering a rich, flavorful, and powerfully balanced high. With a sweet, citrusy, and creamy vanilla aroma, Gelato 33 offers a perfect fusion of euphoria and relaxation. The initial wave of uplifting cerebral energy melts into a calming, full-body bliss, making it the ultimate go-to for stress relief, creativity, and pure chill vibes.
